description: This file contains automated UI tests for the scientific mode of a calculator application, using the MSTest framework. It includes setup and cleanup routines, and multiple test cases covering mathematical functions, trigonometry, and advanced operations.

classes.name: ScientificModeFunctionalTests
classes.description: Contains UI test cases for the scientific mode of the calculator, covering functions, trigonometry, and advanced operations.

methods.name: ClassInitialize
methods.description: Sets up the calculator session and prepares the calculator in scientific mode before tests run.

methods.name: ClassCleanup
methods.description: Tears down the calculator session after all tests have completed.

methods.name: TestInit
methods.description: Initializes the calculator to a cleared state and sets default operator modes before each test.

methods.name: TestCleanup
methods.description: Clears the calculator after each test to ensure test independence.

methods.name: SmokeTest_Cube
methods.description: Tests the cube function (x^3) for input 3, expecting result 27.

methods.name: SmokeTest_Sin
methods.description: Tests the sine function at 90 degrees, expecting result 1.

methods.name: SmokeTest_Tanh
methods.description: Tests the hyperbolic tangent at 90 degrees, expecting result 1.

methods.name: SmokeTest_InvCos
methods.description: Tests the inverse cosine of 1, expecting 0 degrees.

methods.name: SmokeTest_Floor
methods.description: Tests the floor function on 5.9, expecting 5.

methods.name: SmokeTest_Parentheses
methods.description: Tests expression with parentheses and multiplication, expecting 12.

methods.name: SmokeTest_CloseParenthesis
methods.description: Tests nested parentheses and verifies expression and result, including history.

methods.name: SmokeTest_RadianAngleOperator
methods.description: Sets angle mode to radians and tests cosine of Pi, expecting -1.

methods.name: SmokeTest_GradianAngleOperator
methods.description: Sets angle mode to gradians and tests sine of 100 gradians, expecting 1.

methods.name: SmokeTest_FixedToExponential
methods.description: Tests conversion to exponential notation.

methods.name: Operator_XPowerY
methods.description: Tests the power function with base 3 and exponent 5, expecting 243.
